findings.title: Borrowed `config.features` pointer can be freed by `BundleOptions.deinit`.
findings.body:
Here the transpiler is given a pointer to `config.features`, which `JSBundler.Config` owns. `BundleOptions.deinit` now treats any non-static `bundler_feature_flags` as heap-allocated by the transpiler. It calls `deinit()` and then `allocator.destroy()` on it.

If this transpiler is ever deinitialized, that is an invalid free of a struct field. It is followed by a double free when `Config.deinit` frees `features` again.

Fix: either copy the set into a transpiler-owned allocation, or track ownership with a flag so `deinit` only frees sets it created.

findings.title: Feature flags are not part of the runtime transpiler cache key.
findings.body:
`feature()` calls are folded to literals using `bundler_feature_flags`. However, `hashForRuntimeTranspiler` does not include the flag set. With `bun run`, a cached transpilation of a large file made with one `--feature` set is reused under a different set, so the wrong branch runs.

Fix: hash the sorted enabled flags into the cache key, or bypass the runtime transpiler cache when the file imports `bun:bundle` or any flags are set.
